record.tranche_reason: The article says it applied a weight edit to its own model and states that refusal was taken out. This bears on refusal removal, but it does not report the original activation-projection method or quantitative testing.
record.gate_note: The article repeats findings attributed to Arditi et al. and reports a 0 of 200 harmful-prompt refusal result attributed to Abliterix; these are results from other work and are not recorded as rows. Its own Qwen build is described qualitatively, without a behavioral benchmark.
record.test_reason: A promotional blog post. It applies abliteration to build its own Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 release. It only asserts, with no prompt set, refusal rate, baseline or capability benchmark, that refusal was 'taken out' and knowledge and reasoning kept. That is using the finding as a tool, with no measured result bearing on any version. The Arditi et al. results and the Abliterix 0/200 result are cited from other work.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The article presents abliteration as a trivial, public way to remove refusal, with the rest of the model largely intact. It frames uncensored models as research-only artifacts for interpretability, red-teaming and robustness work, never to be deployed for end users. It advises researchers to measure refusal, over-refusal and KL divergence rather than rely on anecdote, but reports no such measurements itself.
record.recipe_differences: The article describes estimating a direction at one layer and orthogonalizing it out of residual-writing weight matrices. It does not specify the harmful-minus-harmless extraction procedure or test activation projection across every layer and position.
record.problems: The article is promotional and gives no methods, prompts, refusal or capability measurements, controls, or uncertainty for its own build. Its behavioral and capability claims are qualitative.
record.rows_left_out: No rows omitted. The reported 0 of 200 refusal result is attributed to Abliterix, not this article's own experiment.

untested.parts: No measured refusal rate before or after the edit, no harmful-prompt benchmark, no over-refusal check, no KL divergence or capability benchmark for the article's own build.
No difference-in-means extraction, activation ablation, direction addition, or capability evaluation is reported.

missing.what: The article points to a model card holding a 'benchmark table' for its build. That table is not in this text, so any refusal or capability numbers there are unrecorded.
missing.locator: How to run one responsibly; link to orcarouter model card

record.verdict_notes: The reader's 'tests'/T2 and its supports labels for V1 and V2 are dropped. The only evidence on the article's own build is a vendor's unmeasured assertion, and verdicts need a number or an explicit tested result. The cited Abliterix figure (0 of 200 refusals on a 0.8B Qwen3.5) and the Heretic timing figures belong to other work and are correctly excluded as rows.

versions.untested_parts: The article does not report a harmful-minus-harmless mean-activation calculation, activation projection at every layer and position, adding the direction, or a measured evaluation of general capability.
Only the article's own Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 build is described; no refusal rate or independent evaluation is reported.

rows.subject: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8
rows.operation_detail: Estimated a refusal direction at a single layer and removed it from 131 residual-writing matrices; the vision tower was left untouched.
rows.value: The article says refusal was taken out.
rows.locator: The research that created them; What 'uncensored' actually means
rows.note: Qualitative claim about the article's own build; no prompt set, refusal rate, or evaluation procedure is given.
rows.check: This is a weight edit (orthogonalization over 131 matrices), which is V2, not V1's activation ablation or addition. There is no baseline, prompt set or refusal rate, only the unmeasured claim 'with refusal taken out'. A promotional assertion cannot show the effect.

rows.subject: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8
rows.operation_detail: Estimated a refusal direction at a single layer and removed it from 131 residual-writing matrices; the vision tower was left untouched.
rows.measure: Capability preservation (knowledge, reasoning, and context length)
rows.value: The article describes the build as retaining the same knowledge and reasoning, with a 262,144-token context.
rows.note: These are qualitative assertions; no capability benchmark or comparison is reported.
rows.check: The capability claim ('same knowledge, the same reasoning') is asserted without any benchmark or comparison to the base model. The 262,144-token context is a spec, not a capability measure. The value cannot be read as evidence.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
